verdict.rationale: The evidence says flows start from a trigger, but nothing documents a schedule, cron, or interval trigger that runs flows or agents on a recurring basis. The changelog example of typing "summarise my unread emails every morning" only says this produces a drafted agent (name, instructions, tools). It does not say a recurring schedule is configured, so it is a hypothetical prompt example, not affirmative support for scheduling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
